published.title: Testing exotic electron-electron interactions with the helium ionization-energy anomaly
published.summary: Uses the helium ionization-energy anomaly to test exotic interactions between electrons.

published.title: Magnetic resonance searches for Earth-sourced exotic nuclear spin-dependent interactions
published.summary: Searches for long-range nuclear-spin-dependent interactions sourced by Earth using magnetic resonance.

published.title: Constraints on New Vector Boson Mediated Electron-Nucleus Interactions from Spectroscopy Data of Polar Diatomic Molecules
published.summary: Extracts electron-nucleus constraints on new vector bosons from precision molecular spectroscopy.

published.title: Axial-vector leptophilic fifth force sourced by solar neutrinos
published.summary: Studies an axial-vector leptophilic fifth force sourced by the solar-neutrino flux and its laboratory signatures.

published.title: Stringent Constraints on New Pseudoscalar and Vector Bosons from Precision Hyperfine Splitting Measurements
published.summary: Uses precision hyperfine splittings in highly charged ions to constrain new pseudoscalar and vector bosons.

published.title: Proposal for the search for exotic spin-mass interaction in the micrometer range
published.summary: Proposes a dedicated micrometer-range search for exotic monopole-dipole spin-mass interactions.

published.title: New Upper Bounds on Exotic Neutron-Spin–Electron-Spin Interactions via Neutron-Spin-Rotation Measurements in a Compensated Ferrimagnet
published.summary: Constrains neutron-electron spin interactions using neutron spin rotation in a compensated ferrimagnet.

published.title: Novel torsion-balance approach to probe exotic spin-dependent interactions
published.summary: Develops a torsion-balance approach for probing velocity- and spin-dependent interactions.

published.title: Fermion-Selective Tests of New Physics with the Bound-Electron g Factor
published.summary: Uses bound-electron g-factor comparisons to perform fermion-selective tests of new interactions.

published.title: Exotic-interaction searches on small scales via near-threshold enhancement
published.summary: Introduces near-threshold enhancement as a route to amplify short-range exotic-interaction signals.

preprints.title: Probing Exotic Electron-Electron Interactions via Adiabatic Spin Inversion in MRFM
preprints.summary: Proposes an MRFM search using adiabatic spin inversion for short-range exotic electron-electron interactions.

preprints.title: Neutron Optical Constraints on Exotic Parity-odd Interactions between Neutrons and Nucleons
preprints.summary: Uses neutron-optical parity-violation measurements to constrain parity-odd neutron-nucleon interactions.

preprints.title: Projected sensitivity of a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate comagnetometer to proton monopole-dipole interactions
preprints.summary: Evaluates a spinor-BEC comagnetometer for direct proton monopole-dipole searches at submillimeter ranges.

preprints.title: Atomic structure calculations for constraining new electron-electron forces
preprints.summary: Develops atomic-structure calculations for parity-odd electron-electron forces and extracts new bounds.

preprints.title: Precision Positronium Spectroscopy as a Test of the Helium Ionization Energy Anomaly
preprints.summary: Assesses positronium spectroscopy as an independent test of a possible scalar explanation of the helium anomaly.

preprints.title: New Bounds on Exotic Long-Range Spin-Spin Interactions
preprints.summary: Reports new long-range electron-nucleon bounds using a rotating mercury-cesium comagnetometer and Earth as a spin source.

preprints.title: A Levitated-Magnet Vector Force Sensor for Spin-Dependent Exotic Interactions
preprints.summary: Develops a levitated-ferromagnet vector force sensor that separates directional signatures of spin-dependent interactions.

preprints.title: Axion-Exchange Contribution to the Energy of Lithium-Like Ions
preprints.summary: Calculates axion-exchange energy shifts in lithium-like ions and derives high-mass constraints from precision spectroscopy.
